thesis: Fluency, discovery, learning and reward illuminate aesthetic experience without reducing its content or value to a single mechanism.

ideas.statement: Difficulty that becomes intelligible can enrich appreciation; familiar return also matters, so compression needs falsifiable predictions.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Brain imaging correlates with ratings in particular tasks, not objective beauty; shared mechanisms do not erase differences in content.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Brain imaging correlates with ratings in particular tasks, not objective beauty; shared mechanisms do not erase differences in content.

audit.notes: Direct active-LLM analysis of every unit; chapter labels excluded.
